services.name: smart-traffic-monitoring-api-mock
services.description: API for managing traffic flows, detecting incidents, and enforcing road regulations across the city. Compatible with cross-domain orchestration: use this service to query congestion levels in specific zones (zoneId), filter active incidents, or act as an actuator (e.g., dynamically lowering speed limits in response to pollution alerts from the Sensors API). Supports filtering by zone, congestion level, incident status, and sensor activity.

capabilities.GET /health: Health check endpoint to verify that the Smart Traffic Monitoring microservice is reachable and responsive.
capabilities.GET /traffic-sensor:
Retrieve traffic sensors deployed across the city. Use query parameters to filter by zone, congestion level, incident status, or sensor activity - for example to find all active sensors with critical congestion in Z-CENTRO, or all sensors currently detecting an incident, or all inactive sensors for maintenance.

**Mock constraint — one filter per request**: this mock dispatcher resolves a single query parameter at a time. Combining multiple query parameters is NOT supported — only the primary dispatcher parameter is matched. Issue separate requests for each filter and merge results client-side.
capabilities.POST /traffic-sensor: Register a new traffic monitoring sensor in the city traffic control system.
capabilities.GET /traffic-sensor/{id}: Retrieve real-time traffic data from a specific sensor by ID.
capabilities.PUT /traffic-sensor/{id}: Update the data of a specific traffic sensor by ID.
capabilities.DELETE /traffic-sensor/{id}: Remove a specific traffic monitoring sensor from the city registry.
capabilities.PUT /traffic-sensor/zone/{zoneId}/speed-: Dynamically enforce a new speed limit on digital road signs for an entire city zone. Use this to react to environmental hazards (high pollution, frost warning) or traffic congestion detected by sensors.
capabilities.POST /register: Register this microservice with the central discovery system (Consul).
